entities.summary: Germanic Visigoths, a notable figure in the history of Spain, associated with Visigoths & Al-Andalus (409–711). Preceded by Visigothic Kingdom of Toledo. Their legacy influenced Umayyad forces under Tariq ibn Ziyad defeat the Visigoths at Guadalete and Umayyad Caliphate of Córdoba.
